conclusions.text: Pinned 228-member scope and input digests reproduce; individual legal/source/geographic correctness remains unresolved.
The official 2012 INS census roster supports 190 exact scoped name/department joins, 10 documented spelling/role aliases, and four candidate but unresolved Tibiri(Doutchi) parent mappings.

The 2020 Mauritania source lacks the six Moughataa units named in a 2021 government notice; official snapshots report 61 units in a document dated 2022 and 63 in DGAT’s later RGPH 2024 summary, leaving the current roster transition unresolved.
Underlying-source redistribution rights for NER geometry remain unresolved; raw NER files were not retained in the public packet.
Ecological fragment intersections are diagnostic and unresolved as a geographic tier and boundary purpose.
All 13 scoped 2020 Mauritania ADM2 candidates overlap a 2015 ADM1 candidate whose name agrees with the Atlas parent; this is not current legal verification.
